_notes: Register: both consoles use magázás. Agency addresses the single staff member as Ön; University addresses the institution/team as Önök and the individual user as Ön (decision.readOnly, settings.you), following the existing Hungarian.
Caseload (Agency CRM term) rendered as 'ügyfélkör' everywhere (was 'ügyfelei köre' / 'támogatott hallgatói'); 'pipeline' = 'folyamat', 'stage' = 'szakasz', 'status' = 'állapot'.

Document review in the consoles = 'dokumentumellenőrzés' (verb 'ellenőriz'), the verify action stays 'jóváhagyás' as in the existing strings; essay review = 'esszéértékelés' to match common:nav/taskType.

Offer/admission: 'ajánlat' (Ajánlat kiküldve / Ajánlat elfogadva) in both consoles and in the shared common chips; 'not admitted' = 'fel nem vett', never 'elutasított' except for the explicit Reject action.
Standard admission letter (표준입학허가서) spelled out once per screen as 'standard felvételi levél (standard admission letter)'; short status labels keep 'felvételi levél'. 'felvételi igazolás' removed.

Submitted applications in the University console unified on 'beadott/beadva' (v25 insight strings used 'beküldött'); common:appStatus.SUBMITTED still says 'Beküldve' — owner may want to align that chip later.
SLA, GPA, KTX, CHSI, SAML, OpenID Connect, D-2/D-4 kept as codes; 'single sign-on' = 'egyszeri bejelentkezés (SSO)' on first use.
Plural forms: hu has one/other; every _one string carries {{count}} as required by the plural rule.
agency:v28.stage.of rewritten as '{{n}}. szakasz (összesen {{total}})' and university:v22.in.dropText as '{{of}} közül {{lost}} …' so no Hungarian suffix is glued to a placeholder.
